title: Swedish regions, actual monthly employment
exposure_kind: regional THAIE quintiles, not occupational quintiles
note: All occupations within each county. This is not monthly software-developer employment. Exposure weights cover about 67–78% of published 2022 occupation mass, conditional on deterministic links and scored occupations. Unadjusted for seasonality; each series uses its own 2022 12-month mean = 100. Exact requested ages are unavailable.
